note: Sample-level click trains (A1-02). Same closed-form signal model as vad-phase-sweep.json.

cases.derivation: A click is 24 samples (0.5 ms) of amplitude 0.5 in the middle of a 2400-sample frame: frame power = (24 * 0.25 + 2376 * 1e-6) / 2400 = 0.002501 -> -26.02 dBFS, i.e. about +33.98 dB over the -60 dBFS floor: a candidate (and an opening frame). All other frames are background (rel 0). Clicks every 2 frames leave 1 quiet frame(s) between clicks: fewer than 6, so all 4 clicks are bridged into ONE segment with 4 candidate frames but a longest run of 1 < 3: rejected (rejected count 1).

cases.description: 4 pairs of clicks in adjacent frames, 1 quiet frame between pairs.
cases.derivation: A click is 24 samples (0.5 ms) of amplitude 0.5 in the middle of a 2400-sample frame: frame power = (24 * 0.25 + 2376 * 1e-6) / 2400 = 0.002501 -> -26.02 dBFS, i.e. about +33.98 dB over the -60 dBFS floor: a candidate (and an opening frame). All other frames are background (rel 0). Pairs: candidate frames 10-11, 13-14, 16-17, 19-20: 8 candidate frames, longest run 2 < 3: rejected.

cases.description: Positive control: clicks in 3 adjacent frames then 1 quiet frame, twice.
cases.derivation: A click is 24 samples (0.5 ms) of amplitude 0.5 in the middle of a 2400-sample frame: frame power = (24 * 0.25 + 2376 * 1e-6) / 2400 = 0.002501 -> -26.02 dBFS, i.e. about +33.98 dB over the -60 dBFS floor: a candidate (and an opening frame). All other frames are background (rel 0). Frames 10-12 and 14-16 are clicks, frame 13 is quiet (bridged): 6 candidate frames with a longest run of 3: ACCEPTED. One segment, onset 10*50 = 500 ms, end 17*50 = 850 ms.

cases.description: Positive control: a click in each of 4 adjacent frames.
cases.derivation: A click is 24 samples (0.5 ms) of amplitude 0.5 in the middle of a 2400-sample frame: frame power = (24 * 0.25 + 2376 * 1e-6) / 2400 = 0.002501 -> -26.02 dBFS, i.e. about +33.98 dB over the -60 dBFS floor: a candidate (and an opening frame). All other frames are background (rel 0). Frames 10-13: 4 candidate frames, run 4: accepted (a click in every frame is indistinguishable from a continuous sound by level alone).
